notes.title: The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival!
notes.content:
We're proud to participate in The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival as a Southeast Asian game studio 🇮🇩

We're extending our Steam Next Fest demo to be available during the event, till the end of March! So if you haven't had a chance to check it out during Steam Next Fest, you'll have the whole month of March to play through the demo!

As always, wishlist the game if you haven't, it helps us so much! If you have any feedback about the demo, comment below or leave a post in the Community Hub 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2482180/As_I_Began_to_Dream/

notes.title: As I Began To Dream’s quickfire tile-flipping gives its puzzles a satisfying snap
notes.content:
I like to think that, having been supplanted by autoshooters and twig-picking survival games as the Steam Next Fest genre du jour, 2D puzzle-platformers can circle back from ubiquity to becoming cool and clever again. In any event, I’ve definitely enjoyed As I Began To Dream, a charmingly hand-drawn side-scroller that delivers its puzzles with a tactile clickiness straight out of your childhood toolbox. The demo is out now.

notes.title: Update Patch Demo AIBTDv2.5.2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have exciting news to share in the latest update for As I Began to Dream version 2.5.2!

Responding to numerous requests from our demo players in Indonesia, we are pleased to announce the addition of the Indonesian language to our game demo. Now, all dialogues in the game have been localized for Indonesian players. We hope this update enhances your experience with the As I Began to Dream demo. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

In addition to the language addition, this update includes:
Flippy now provides hints if players find difficulty navigating levels.
Enhanced immersion with the addition of Fauna and Flora elements in the game.
New animations for Lily's parents.
New visual effects for various in-game objects.
Improved clarity in certain parts of the game.

Thank you for your attention and support. If you have any feedback or suggestions for our game, feel free to share them on our Steam forum or [url=https://discord.gg/s7QmTTuN2n]Discord[/url].
